02. 05.12.2014
The Petitioner seeks quashing of the order of cognizance dated 21.02.2013 passed by the 2nd Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Food Safety and Standards Act, Muzaffarpur in Case No. C-06 of 2013.
Considering that the Petitioner seeks quashing on the procedure as specific by law which does not affect the legality of the Act, I am not inclined to interfere in the matter.
